number patterns.summary: Patterns formed by numbers following a rule.

triangular numbers.definition: Numbers formed by adding counting numbers successively.

square numbers.definition: Numbers formed by multiplying a number by itself.

cube numbers.definition: Numbers formed by multiplying a number by itself twice.

virahanka sequence.definition: Each term equals the sum of the previous two terms.

visual patterns.summary: Patterns represented using shapes and arrangements.

square dot patterns.definition: Dots arranged in equal rows and columns forming a square.

triangle dot patterns.definition: Dots arranged in increasing rows forming a triangle.

shape representations.definition: The same number can sometimes be represented by different shapes.

odd sums and squares.definition: Successive odd-number sums produce perfect squares.

triangular number formation.definition: Triangular numbers are formed from counting-number sums.

powers of two patterns.definition: Partial sums of powers of two follow predictable growth patterns.

geometric patterns.summary: Patterns formed using shapes and geometric structures.

polygons.definition: Closed shapes with three or more sides.

complete graphs.definition: Graphs where every vertex is connected to every other vertex.

stacked shapes.definition: Shapes that grow layer by layer.

koch snowflake.definition: A repeating geometric pattern where segments multiply at each stage.
